summary.headline: Division of the Climates
summary.text: Discussion of planetary participations in the qualities, colors, virtues, and vices of regional peoples, including the philosophers’ land; Chapter 32 introduces the division of climates by the twelve signs, 360 degrees, and 21,600 minutes, with applications to solar revolutions and the ascending degree.
